_comment: check-docs config. Copied once from jig's scaffold, then owned by this project. Set repo to <owner>/<name>. rosters: which docs claim a COMPLETE skill/agent roster (check-docs verifies them both ways). historical: docs whose citations describe a past state on purpose and are exempt from the live-path check, each with a reason. knownForeign / knownForeignAgents: slash commands and agents named in docs that belong to other tools, so the roster check does not flag them. Every project's copy differs; that is the point.

historical.docs/RETROSPECTIVES.md: per-phase record of what was true at phase close
historical.docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md: closed task rows cite what they retired
